description:
Job Summary: Associate Data Inventory Analyst

The Associate Revenue Cycle Analyst - Inventory Analyst is responsible for driving operational excellence and data integrity across revenue cycle inventory for the Payment and Correspondence Posting Teams. This role monitors, reconciles, and reports on the volume, aging, and status of work inventory (e.g., ERA, EOB, correspondence letters…) and the underlying data that supports it. The analyst identifies stagnation, discrepancies, and process variances, and partners with internal teams and vendor partners to ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met. The ideal candidate has working knowledge of RCM, shows initiative, works independently, and proactively identifies and resolves data and inventory variances. This role plays a key part in ensuring data integrity, process compliance, and the accuracy of reporting that supports financial operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Data Inventory Management: Maintains an accurate, current view of revenue cycle inventory across designated posting workstreams, including inflow, work in progress, aging, and backlog. Validates that inventory data is complete, accurate, and consistent across source systems, and reconciles discrepancies.
  • Industry Knowledge: Demonstrates working knowledge of RCM posting business processes, including the ability to interpret payor remittances, explanation of benefits (EOBs), claim statuses, and related data elements (e.g., CARCs, RARCs, adjustments) as they relate to inventory categorization and reporting.
  • System Proficiency: Demonstrates proficiency in the programs and systems required for the assigned workstream. This includes, but is not limited to: AdvancedMD (AMD), Salesforce, Jira, Snowflake, and Google Workspace.
  • KPI Reporting: Builds, maintains, and distributes recurring reports and dashboards on key metrics, including inventory volumes, aging, production, backlog, SLA adherence, and data quality or error rates.
  • Data Quality & Vendor Partnership: Serves as the operational analyst to identify trends, anomalies, and areas of underperformance in inventory and data quality. Works directly with vendor partners and management to drive improvements, including participating in recurring functional review calls to align on process and resolve roadblocks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partners with colleagues within the department and across departments (e.g., Claims, Audit, Denials) to ensure inventory data is accurate, accessible, and useful to downstream processes.
  • Issue Investigation & Resolution: Performs deep-dive investigations into data discrepancies and inventory anomalies to identify root cause, recommend workflow or data adjustments, and escalate systemic issues to management to drive continuous performance improvement.
  • Subject Matter Expert Competencies: Demonstrates strong critical thinking, initiative, organization, attention to detail, confidentiality, thoroughness, decision making, independent work, data analysis, and a results-driven approach.
  • PHI Protection: This role works with PHI on a regular basis, in both paper and electronic form, and has access to various technologies to access PHI in order to perform the job. Proper PHI-handling actions are required.
  • Natera Trainings: Employee must complete required Natera HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies, Security, and Compliance training no later than the first 30 days of hire and ongoing as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) OR
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, data analysis, or inventory/queue management, with exposure to reporting and data reconciliation.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Inventory Oversight: Ability to track and manage high-volume inventory (posting documents such as ERA, EOB, correspondence) and identify points of failure or stagnation within a process.
  • Technical Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking skills to troubleshoot data discrepancies and logic errors between source systems, payor data, and internal reporting.
  • Data Proficiency: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, Data Visualization). Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools is a plus.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to influence and work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Analytical Communication: Ability to translate complex data into clear, concise reports for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Data Accuracy: Understanding of healthcare terminology and revenue cycle data elements, and the attention to detail needed to maintain data integrity.
  • Discretion: Strict adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality protocols regarding sensitive patient and financial data.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.
